patch.detail:
Only four anonymous marketing URLs on the desktop preset are measured; no JS-size assertion, so the member shell is unmeasured.

lighthouserc.mobile.json runs the mobile preset over the home and the signed-out /feed (the real member shell) with LCP, CLS, TBT and a script-size assertion, as warns until a few runs set the numbers; the e2e.yml lighthouse job runs it and prints the medians and script KB into the job summary.
